# Overview

Confluencia provides R bindings to a Python backend for circRNA therapeutic
evaluation. Before using any `cf_*` function, you need a Python environment
with the Confluencia dependencies installed (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn,
scipy, joblib, rdkit).

```r
library(confluencia)

# Point to your Python (only needed once per session)
cf_use_python("/path/to/python")
```

# PK Simulation

## Small-molecule CTM model

```r
# Derive parameters from micro scores
params <- cf_ctm_params(binding = 0.72, immune = 0.65, inflammation = 0.12)

# Simulate 72-hour PK profile
pk <- cf_ctm_simulate(dose = 200, freq = 2, binding = 0.72, horizon = 72)
head(pk)

# Plot efficacy signal
plot(pk$time_h, pk$efficacy_signal, type = "l",
     xlab = "Time (h)", ylab = "Efficacy Signal",
     main = "CTM 6-Compartment PK")
```

## circRNA RNA-CTM model

```r
# Pseudouridine-modified circRNA via LNP
rna_pk <- cf_rna_ctm_simulate(dose = 5, freq = 1,
                               modification = "pseudouridine",
                               horizon = 168)
head(rna_pk)
```

Supported modifications: `"none"`, `"m6A"`, `"pseudouridine"`, `"5mC"`, `"ms2m6A"`.

# Immunogenicity Prediction

```r
scores <- cf_circrna_immunogenicity("ACGUACGUACGUACGUACGUACGUACGUACGU")
print(scores)
```

# MHC Encoding

```r
# MHC-I features (1018 dimensions)
enc <- cf_mhc_encode("SLYNTVATL", "HLA-A*02:01")
length(enc)  # 1018

# Detect MHC class
cf_mhc_detect_class("HLA-A*02:01")  # "I"
cf_mhc_detect_class("HLA-DRB1*04:01")  # "II"
```

# 5D Joint Evaluation

```r
result <- cf_joint_evaluate(
  smiles = "CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O",
  epitope_seq = "SLYNTVATL",
  mhc_allele = "HLA-A*02:01",
  dose_mg = 200,
  freq_per_day = 2,
  treatment_time = 72
)
cat("Composite:", result$composite, "\n")
cat("Recommendation:", result$recommendation, "\n")
```

# Model Training (DBTL Learn Stage)

When new experimental data become available, you can retrain models to close
the DBTL loop:

```r
# Train drug model from your CSV
drug_result <- cf_drug_train("my_drug_data.csv", model_name = "ridge")
cat("Drug R2:", drug_result$r2, "\n")
cat("Bundle saved to:", drug_result$bundle_path, "\n")

# Use the trained model for prediction
pred <- cf_drug_predict(drug_result$bundle_path, "CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O")

# Train epitope model
epitope_result <- cf_epitope_train("my_epitope_data.csv",
                                    target_col = "efficacy",
                                    model_name = "hgb")
pred <- cf_epitope_predict(epitope_result$bundle_path, "SLYNTVATL")
```

Supported model types for training:

| Module | Models | Default |
|--------|--------|---------|
| Drug | ridge, rf, gbr, hgb, mlp | gbr |
| Epitope | ridge, rf, hgb, mlp | hgb |

# Regression Metrics

```r
metrics <- cf_reg_metrics(c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), c(1.1, 1.9, 3.1, 3.8, 5.2))
print(metrics)
```

# Plugin System (Extensible Platform)

Confluencia is an extensible platform -- you can register custom models,
encoders, PK solvers, and evaluation dimensions.

```r
# Register XGBoost as a new model type (requires xgboost Python package)
cf_register_model("xgboost", "xgboost", "XGBRegressor")

# Train with the registered model
result <- cf_drug_train("data.csv", model_name = "xgboost")

# Add a new evaluation dimension
cf_register_dimension("manufacturability", weight = 0.10,
                      description = "Ease of large-scale production")

# Customize scoring weights
cf_set_weights(c(clinical = 0.25, binding = 0.20, kinetics = 0.15,
                 gene_signature = 0.15, circrna = 0.15, manufacturability = 0.10))

# View all registered components
cf_list_plugins()
```

# Community Sharing (Confluencia Hub)

```r
# Share your trained model (federated -- no raw data exposed)
cf_hub_push_model(result$bundle_path, strip_env_medians = TRUE)

# Download and use community models
models <- cf_hub_list_models(task = "drug")
community <- cf_hub_pull_model("hub:drug:anonymous:abc123")
pred <- cf_drug_predict(community$bundle_path, "CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O")

# Optionally contribute data (anonymous, with license)
cf_hub_push_data("my_data.csv", license = "CC-BY-4.0", anonymous = TRUE)
cf_hub_data_stats()
```
